pages.label: Getting Started
pages.description: New here? Start with this guide

components.content:
# Welcome to the Server Guide!
This guide will help you get familiar with our community. Use the navigation below to explore different topics.

**Quick Tips:**
- Read the rules to stay in good standing
- Check out our channels to find your interests
- Join voice channels when they're active
- Have fun and be respectful!

# About Us
Welcome to our community! We're a group of passionate gamers and friends who enjoy hanging out, playing games, and having fun together.

# Server Rules
Please follow these guidelines to keep our community welcoming:
1. **Be Respectful** - Treat everyone with kindness
2. **No Spam** - Keep channels clean and on-topic
3. **No NSFW** - Keep content appropriate
4. **Have Fun** - That's what we're here for!

# Channel Guide
Here's an overview of our server channels. Select a category below to learn more.

# General Channels
Our social channels are open to everyone. Come hang out, share memes, and chat about anything!

# Gaming Channels
Dedicated spaces for game discussions, clips, strategies, and finding people to play with.

pages.label: Bot Commands
pages.description: Available bot commands and how to use them

components.content:
# Bot Commands
Our bots provide various features. Select a category below to see available commands.

# Basic Commands
- `/help` - Show this guide
- `/suggest` - Submit a suggestion
- `/info` - View server information

# Game Commands
- `/uno` - Start a UNO game
- `/hangman` - Play Hangman
- `/tictactoe` - Play Tic-Tac-Toe

# Frequently Asked Questions
**Q: How do I get roles?**
Check the role selection channel for self-assignable roles.

**Q: How do I report someone?**
Use the modmail system or contact a moderator directly.

**Q: Can I suggest features?**
Yes! Use the `/suggest` command to submit your ideas.
